name: SPZCO
summary: SPZCO is a stock research terminal for investors who want U.S. congressional STOCK Act trades, executive-branch OGE disclosures, 13F institutional filings, and Form 4 insider activity on one page per stock, filer, or official, with screeners and portfolio backtesting built in. Facts and filings are free without a card; the valuation engine and full 13F books are a paid Pro tier, and disclosed trade amounts are the ranges the forms use rather than exact fills.
